vision.name: Black Mischief
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 3.
(If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck by one of your effects, you may Rejuvenate it to choose a card in your discard pile and shuffle it into your Life Deck.)
POWER: Look at the top 5 cards of a player's Life Deck and put them back in any order. Reveal the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. If it is not a Dragon Ball, banish it. [Trait:Saiyan]: Raise your anger 2 levels.
vision.note: inline icon zoomed: green Saiyan badge
